items.prompt: A new requirement changes the data from lowercase-without-spaces to the single string "aa bb". The old supplied parser still uses read().split() and passes only data[0]. What must change?

options.why: The problem occurs before the function: only aa reaches it. Another flush cannot reconstruct the discarded space and bb.

options.text: Keep the parser and count the number of whitespace tokens instead.
options.why: That changes the meaning from character runs to token counts, rather than preserving the new string.

options.text: Sort the tokens and join them without spaces before encoding.
options.why: That destroys the original adjacency and the space character that the new contract includes.

options.text: Preserve the full string with explicit framing and an adapted parser.
options.why: Whitespace tokenization no longer preserves the intended data. The new contract needs explicit framing and a representation for space runs before reusing the algorithm.

items.explanation: Whitespace tokenization no longer preserves the intended data. The new contract needs explicit framing and a representation for space runs before reusing the algorithm.
